blockers: The archived benchmark exposes attribution counters but no controlled bank-ready or response-latency knobs.
The available testbench readiness signals are randomized, so rerunning the same seed is not a sensitivity experiment.
No approved RTL mutation or isolated parameterized snapshot was authorized for this report.
decision: Do not generate an RTL candidate from attribution alone. Add controlled, reviewable readiness/latency parameters in an isolated NMAForge snapshot, then rerun the same source revision and gates.
